## Purpose

Describe the software or scientific problem addressed.

## Evidence role and guardrails

State whether this affects discovery, validation, sensitivity, mechanism or
treatment-response evidence. Explain how participant independence and
provenance are preserved.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] `pytest -q` passes
- [ ] `ruff check axis tests` passes
- [ ] `mypy axis` passes
- [ ] `axis demo` passes
- [ ] No credentials, identifiable participants, controlled data or raw data
- [ ] AI assistance, if used, is disclosed and independently checked
